evals.name: simple-form-generation
evals.prompt: Generate Laravel code from KSP\Transaksi\Pengajuan\FrmPengajuan.pas. Use existing database schema.
evals.expected_output: Generate Model (Pengajuan), Service (PengajuanService), Controller (PengajuanController), and Request (StorePengajuanRequest) files. Model should connect to existing 'dbpengajuan' table.

evals.name: auth-form-generation
evals.prompt: Generate Laravel code from KSP\Application\Login\FrLogin.pas. This is a login/authentication form.
evals.expected_output: Generate User model, LoginController, and LoginRequest. Should detect dbUser table and MyCariUserName function.

evals.name: master-data-form
evals.prompt: Generate Laravel code from KSP\Master\Customer\FrmAnggota.pas. Master data form for customer management.
evals.expected_output: Generate Customer model with relationships to dbarea, dbkota. Service with CRUD operations.

evals.name: table-mapping-validation
evals.prompt: What tables does FrmPengajuan use? Show me the table mapping analysis.
evals.expected_output: Show DFM scan, SQL scan, and config validation results. Primary: dbpengajuan, Related: dbjaminan, dbcustomer, dbproduk.

evals.name: traceability-integration
evals.prompt: Generate Laravel code from KSP\Transaksi\Pengajuan\FrmPengajuan.pas using existing traceability data from docs/traceability/
evals.expected_output: Use existing traceability JSON to map all functions to Laravel equivalents. Show progress of migrated vs pending functions.
